name: travel-memory-sticker-card
title_zh: 旅行照片做成记忆贴纸卡
tagline_zh: 旅行照片收成能收藏的贴纸卡
desc_en: Transform a user-uploaded photograph into one horizontal collectible memory card with a large quiet editorial illustration, six integrated journaling-sticker motifs, three small English keywords beneath the left illustration, tactile paper grain, and deliberately clumsy flat color fields. Use when Codex needs to P图, edit, redraw, stylize, or turn a travel, street, landscape, lifestyle, portrait, o
why_zh: 产出是能收藏的贴纸卡，不是又一段旅行 vlog 文案。
limit_zh: 卡片规格锁死。要长图文笔记、要地图轨迹，不是这件的活。
